name: London Project affiliate layout standard v5 - fixed 6-category randomized Coupang mix
selection_principles: This v5 policy supersedes every older affiliate category-mix instruction in the repository.
Each article has exactly three branded header buttons in one horizontal row: Coupang Partners (orange), OLIVE YOUNG (green), Trip.com (blue), in that order.
The header must use branded/logo-style tiles and each button must use a real verified tracking URL authorized for that destination.
Do not render the old large navy generic buttons or raw Unicode-escaped Trip.com category link rows.
All ten bottom product cards are Coupang Partners products only.
Every article must contain exactly: 2 beauty/cosmetics, 1 laptop, 1 tablet, 2 health supplements, 2 Korea travel packages, and 2 hotel products.
Build a site-specific pool of approximately 100 verified Coupang offers: 20 beauty, 10 laptops, 10 tablets, 20 health supplements, 20 Korea travel packages, 20 hotel products.
Randomly select products independently per article while preserving the exact category counts; avoid repeating the same ten-product set across articles.
Use genuine account-generated Coupang tracking links and verified official product images. Never invent products, links, images, prices, sales, reviews or commission rates.
Keep separate product pools per destination; never share WordPress and Blogger catalogs.
Agoda remains disabled. Olive Young and Trip.com are header buttons only, not product-card providers.
Preserve editorial body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the designated affiliate block.
